newsitem.title: USA: Vitalink offers no opinion on Manor bid.
newsitem.headline: Vitalink offers no opinion on Manor bid.

text.p: Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc said Wednesday it is not making a recommendation as to whether Vitalink stockholders should tender their common shares in response to an offer by Manor Care Inc.

Vitalink said it has filed a statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a proposed tender offer by Manor Care to purchase 1.5 million shares of common stock of Vitalink at a purchase price of $20.00 per share.
Manor Care currently owns about 45 percent of the outstanding common stock of Vitalink and has designated one half of the directors of Vitalink.

On April 18, Manor Care's directors authorized a tender offer be launched April 24 for up to 1.5 million shares or about six percent of Vitalink's shares. The offer would raise Manor Care's stake to more than 50 percent allowing Manor Care to consolidate Vitalink for financial reporting purposes.
As a result of existing and potential conflicts of interest, Vitalink said it did not express an opinion on the offer. The conflicts of interest were not identified.
Vitalink provides medications, consulting, infusion and other ancillary services to about 172,000 institutional beds as well as to home infusion patients.
